title: Tiered Compliance + SLA Activation Matrix and Observability Retention Experiment
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Evaluate a conditional activation model that ties observability retention tiers, a bundled Compliance Pack (security questionnaire + audit artifacts), and an optional Premium SLA into a single pricing/entitlement experiment. Hypothesis: A configurable activation matrix (usage thresholds + sales override + questionnaire pass) will increase attach rate for paid observability tiers and Compliance Pack adoption while preserving margin and lowering support friction for enterprise customers. Scope: design the activation matrix, entitlement flags, security-questionnaire gating flow, contract language snippets for sales, UI affordances in Console, and a 12-week A/B experiment with cohorted rollout. Exclusions: deep contract negotiations, on-prem install changes beyond entitlement checks, and advanced legal redlines (those will be escalated). Success metrics: 1) +MRR from observability retention upsells >= 12% in exposed cohorts, 2) Compliance Pack attach rate >= 6% for accounts > $5k ARR, 3) Net support ticket delta from gated rollouts <= +10% relative to baseline, 4) No P0 security findings post-release. Risk: questionnaire gating may increase time-to-sale; mitigate with a 'sales override' entitlement and a lightweight questionnaire path for pilots.
acceptance_criteria: Activation matrix documented and approved by Legal and Security (Confluence link added)
Entitlement flags implemented in config service and testable in staging
Console mockups and copy reviewed by Design and Product
A/B experiment plan with cohort definitions, telemetry, and dashboards is finalized
Sales-facing contract snippets and playbook published to Drive
Rollout feature flag exists to disable gating for any tenant via admin API
